services.name: Primary care
services.blurb: Check-ups, chronic conditions, referrals, and the same doctor each visit where we can manage it.

services.name: Pediatrics
services.blurb: Newborn through eighteen, school and sports physicals, immunisations.

services.name: Dental
services.blurb: Cleanings, fillings, extractions and dentures. Sliding scale applies here too.

services.name: Behavioral health
services.blurb: Individual counselling, psychiatry, and substance use treatment. Same-week intake.

services.name: Women's health
services.blurb: Prenatal care, family planning, screening and gynecology.

services.name: Pharmacy
services.blurb: On-site pharmacy with 340B pricing for eligible patients.

services.name: Vision
services.blurb: Eye exams and glasses, including the paediatric vision screening schools ask for.

services.name: Walk-in care
services.blurb: No appointment. Colds, sprains, rashes, infections, stitches.
